meta.title: FengYou | Explore Hsinchu, guided by local students
meta.description: A student-made virtual guide that helps international visitors discover Hsinchu's hidden spots, street food and culture.

hero.title: Explore Hsinchu with local students
hero.subtitle: Walk through old city gates, temple-side food stalls and the everyday life tucked into its lanes.

featured.title: First time in Hsinchu? Start here
featured.description: Must-see places picked by students, each with a story behind it.

routes.title: Hsinchu in half a day
routes.description: Themed walking routes, planned in order so you won't get lost.

culture.title: Why "Feng" (wind)?
culture.description: Hsinchu is known as the Windy City. Get to know the wind and you'll know its food and way of life.

footer.tagline: Discovered by students, shared by students, experienced by you.
footer.projectText: FengYou is a local guide started by Hsinchu students. Anyone signed in can share stories and add places, and editors take down anything that breaks the rules.
